FN-W1N6JE9-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 296
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 296 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Insurance by
an undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, dependent on the cost to administer
the registration of rental home marketplace guarantees and investigate violations of this bill.
These obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by: 1) registration fees collected pursuant
to this bill in amounts set by the Commissioner of Insurance, as provided by this bill, to be
deposited into the Insurance Department Fund; and 2) civil penalties collected for violation of
this bill of up to $500 per violation or $10,000 cumulatively.
